mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases k WHERE k.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (#{isAdmin} OR k.visibility = 'open' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_members m WHERE m.kb_id = k.id AND m.user_id = #{userId})) ORDER BY k.created_at

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM llm_settings s JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.workspace_id = s.workspace_id WHERE k.id = #{kbId} AND coalesce(s.chat_model, '') <> '' ) AS has_chat_model, (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS documents, -- 两条轴各有各的进行时：内容还没进库（status），或图还没抽完（graph_status） (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IN ('pending', 'parsing', 'indexing', 'embedding') OR graph_status IN ('queued', 'extracting'))) AS processing, (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (status = 'failed' OR graph_status = 'failed')) AS failed, (SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL) AS entities

SELECT m.user_id, u.user_name AS email, u.nick_name AS display_name, m.role FROM kb_members m JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = m.user_id -- 停用的人不出现在成员列表里（sys_user del_flag='2' 或 status='1'）；成员关系那一行留着 WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' ORDER BY u.nick_name

SELECT k.id AS kb_id, m.role AS member_role, m.created_at AS joined_at, inviter.nick_name AS added_by_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM documents d WHERE d.kb_id = k.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS doc_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM kb_members mm WHERE mm.kb_id = k.id) AS member_count FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN kb_members m ON m.kb_id = k.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN sys_user inviter ON inviter.utopia_uuid = m.added_by WHERE k.id = ANY(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT k.id, m.role AS matrix_role, (k.visibility = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships ws WHERE ws.workspace_id = k.workspace_id AND ws.user_id = #{userId})) AS open_member FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN kb_members m ON m.kb_id = k.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}

INSERT INTO knowledge_bases (id, workspace_id, name, kind, description, is_default, ontology_lang) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{kind}, #{description}, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_bases WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}), COALESCE((SELECT default_ontology_lang FROM deployment_settings LIMIT 1), 'en')) RETURNING *

UPDATE knowledge_bases SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), visibility = COALESCE(#{visibility}, visibility), auto_extend_ontology = COALESCE(#{autoExtendOntology}, auto_extend_ontology), ontology_lang = COALESCE(#{ontologyLang}, ontology_lang), materialize_inferences = COALESCE(#{materializeInferences}, materialize_inferences), inference_interval_minutes = COALESCE(#{inferenceIntervalMinutes}, inference_interval_minutes), auto_type_resolution = COALESCE(#{autoTypeResolution}, auto_type_resolution), governance = COALESCE(#{governance}, governance), -- 从关到开的那一刻记下来：保险丝只数它之后的撤回。SET 右边读的是旧值 governance_since = CASE WHEN #{governance} IS TRUE AND NOT governance THEN now() ELSE governance_since END, -- 人写的约定；清空要送空串，送 null 等于不改（与 description 同一约定） data_conventions = COALESCE(#{dataConventions}, data_conventions), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING *
